title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 exam guide (four official domains and weightings). Not a capture of past exam questions.

items.stem: A manufacturing company replaces large upfront purchases of servers with paying only for the compute and storage it actually uses each month. Which value proposition of the AWS Cloud does this scenario illustrate?
options: Trading fixed capital expense for variable expense
Benefiting from massive economies of scale
Eliminating the need to guess capacity
items.explanation: AWS Cloud shifts IT spend from large upfront capital purchases to variable usage-based billing, so a company pays for what it consumes instead of owning idle capacity.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A cloud architect notes that the price of compute and storage keeps declining because AWS purchases and operates infrastructure in enormous volumes. Which AWS Cloud benefit does this observation describe?
options: Stopping spending on data center maintenance
Trading capital expense for variable expense
items.explanation: Aggregated demand across millions of AWS customers lets AWS buy infrastructure at volume and pass the resulting cost savings back as lower pay-as-you-go prices.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A database team previously bought servers sized for peak holiday traffic and paid for unused capacity all year, but now provisions resources only as demand arrives. Which AWS Cloud benefit is this?
options: Stopping the need to guess capacity
items.explanation: Cloud capacity is elastic and on demand, so teams no longer gamble on peak sizing and can stop over-provisioning to protect against unexpected spikes.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A developer turns a new feature from committed code into a running, deployed service within minutes instead of waiting weeks for hardware procurement. Which AWS Cloud value proposition does this describe?
options: Trading capital expense for variable expense
items.explanation: Self-service, on-demand provisioning shortens the distance between an idea and production, letting organizations develop, test, and launch faster.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A company shuts down its on-premises server room and no longer pays for rack space, power, cooling, or hardware replacement. Which AWS Cloud benefit does this best illustrate?
options: Stopping spend on running and maintaining data centers
Benefiting from massive economies of scale
Guessing capacity instead of planning it
items.explanation: Moving to the cloud removes the fixed cost and operational burden of physical infrastructure so that team effort can concentrate on the business application.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: An e-commerce startup launches identical workloads in several continents within hours of creating the resources, avoiding any need to build local data centers. Which AWS Cloud benefit is this?
options: Stopping the need to guess capacity
Trading capital expense for variable expense
items.explanation: The same global infrastructure is reachable from any AWS Region, so deployments can be duplicated worldwide in minutes rather than months.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: An architect must evaluate a new workload using the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Which list correctly names all six pillars?
options: Availability, Durability, Performance, Cost, Resilience, Automation
Hardware, Software, Networking, Storage, Security, Compliance
Operational excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance efficiency, Cost optimization, Sustainability
Security, Compliance, Performance, Cost, Scalability, Support
items.explanation: The six Well-Architected pillars are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: During a design review a team debates whether Agility is a formal pillar used to evaluate workloads in the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Which statement is correct?
options: Agility is a pillar but applies only to serverless workloads
Agility replaced the Cost optimization pillar
Agility is the most heavily weighted pillar for databases
Agility is not one of the six Well-Architected pillars
items.explanation: The framework uses six named pillars and Agility is not among them, even though agility is a general benefit of cloud computing.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A solutions architect adds redundancy across multiple Availability Zones and automatic failover so a workload continues operating when individual components fail. Which Well-Architected pillar does this primarily support?
items.explanation: Reliability is the pillar focused on recovering from failures and meeting demand, with mechanisms such as multi-AZ redundancy and automated failover.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A security team configures each employee with only the permissions required for their specific job function. Which Well-Architected security design principle is the team applying?
options: Protecting data at rest and in transit
Applying the principle of least privilege
Managing secrets in a dedicated service
items.explanation: Least privilege means granting only the access a user needs, which limits the blast radius of a compromised account.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A developer reworks an application to run as serverless functions that scale automatically with demand instead of managing servers. Which Well-Architected design principle is this an example of?
items.explanation: Serverless removes the need to provision or manage servers and scales with demand, aligning with the performance efficiency pillar of the framework.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A company moves a legacy application from a data center to AWS by recreating the same virtual machines as EC2 instances without changing the architecture. Which of the six common migration strategies is this?
items.explanation: Rehosting, often called lift-and-shift, moves an application to the cloud with no architectural change and is the fastest way to migrate.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: An organization moves an application to AWS and makes small optimizations, such as moving the database to a managed relational service, while keeping the core architecture intact. Which migration strategy does this describe?
items.explanation: Replatforming, or lift-and-tinker, applies light, beneficial changes during migration without redesigning the application itself.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A team rewrites a monolithic application into a cloud-native design using microservices and containers. Which migration strategy are they following?
items.explanation: Rearchitecting modifies or rewrites the application to a cloud-native architecture such as microservices, typically to gain scalability and flexibility.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A company abandons a custom-built internal CRM and instead buys a commercial software-as-a-service product that meets its needs. Which migration strategy is this?
items.explanation: Repurchasing replaces an existing application with a different commercial or SaaS offering, often to drop the cost of custom maintenance.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: A regulator requires a legacy trade-reporting application to remain exactly where it is for the next two years. Under which AWS migration strategy should the application be classified?
items.explanation: Retaining means keeping certain applications on premises and excluding them from the migration, often for compliance or business reasons.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Concepts

items.stem: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which task is the customer required to perform for an EC2 instance?
options: Patching and updating the guest operating system on the instance
Protecting the physical servers in AWS data centers
Maintaining power and cooling at the facility
Applying security updates to the AWS hypervisor
items.explanation: Customers are responsible for security in the cloud, including patching the guest OS of EC2 instances, while AWS secures the lower layers such as hardware and the hypervisor.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: Under the shared responsibility model, which item is AWS responsible for securing?
options: Physical security of data center facilities
items.explanation: AWS protects the physical layer, networking, and hardware of the cloud, while the customer manages everything it configures inside the services.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A customer runs event-driven code on AWS Lambda. Under the shared responsibility model, which responsibility remains with the customer?
options: Writing the function code and configuring its IAM permissions
Securing the host operating system beneath the runtime
items.explanation: With Lambda, AWS manages the servers and runtime while the customer remains responsible for the code, its dependencies, and the IAM permissions it is granted.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A solutions architect must allow an EC2 instance to write to an S3 bucket without embedding long-term access keys in the instance. Which mechanism should be used?
options: Creating an IAM group for the instance
Adding the instance IP to a security group
Opening a network ACL port for the bucket
Attaching an IAM role to the instance
items.explanation: An IAM role grants temporary credentials to an EC2 instance, letting applications call AWS services without storing permanent access keys.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: An IAM user is covered by two policies where one allows an action and another explicitly denies the same action. What happens when the user attempts the action?
options: The action is denied because an explicit deny overrides an allow
The action is allowed because an allow was granted
The deny is ignored because permits win ties
The action is allowed only outside business hours
items.explanation: IAM policy evaluation gives an explicit deny the highest priority, so a deny always overrides any allow on the same action.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A company has 30 engineers who all need the identical set of permissions. What is the most efficient way to manage their IAM permissions?
options: Attach the permissions to the console password
Place the engineers in one IAM group and attach the policies to the group
Create a separate subordinate policy for each engineer
Put all engineers into a single shared IAM user
items.explanation: IAM groups gather users that share access needs, so policies attached to the group apply to every member and change in one place.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A security administrator wants an additional authentication factor so that a stolen password alone cannot grant console access. What should be enabled?
items.explanation: MFA requires a second factor such as a one-time code from a device, so a compromised password is not enough to sign in.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: An instance-level firewall must allow established inbound sessions automatically without the administrator writing reverse rules. Which AWS feature behaves this way?
items.explanation: Security groups are stateful, so return traffic for an allowed connection is permitted automatically, and they act as instance-level virtual firewalls.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A subnet-level firewall must evaluate both inbound and outbound rules and block return traffic unless a matching rule permits it. Which AWS feature is described?
items.explanation: NACLs are stateless subnet-level firewalls that require explicit inbound and outbound rules, including allowed responses to established connections.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A security engineer needs continuous, automated threat detection that inspects account activity for suspicious behavior and produces findings. Which AWS service should be used?
items.explanation: Amazon GuardDuty continuously analyzes data sources such as DNS and VPC flow logs to identify threats and return actionable findings.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A security team must automatically scan EC2 workloads for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure as they are deployed. Which AWS service performs this?
items.explanation: Amazon Inspector assesses the network reachability and software vulnerabilities of workloads to help meet compliance requirements.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A company wants a managed service that protects its web applications from application-layer attacks such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Which service is designed for this?
items.explanation: AWS WAF is a web application firewall that filters and monitors HTTP traffic using rules against common web exploits.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A corporation facing large distributed denial-of-service attacks needs 24/7 DDoS assistance and enhanced mitigations for its hosted applications. Which service provides this?
items.explanation: AWS Shield Advanced adds enhanced DDoS protections, visibility, and 24/7 access to the DDoS Response Team for protected applications.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A compliance officer must download reports that demonstrate AWS compliance with standards such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2. Which AWS portal provides these reports?
items.explanation: AWS Artifact is the self-serve portal for downloading AWS security and compliance reports such as ISO and SOC certifications.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: An internal audit team must automate the collection of evidence across AWS services to prepare for an audit. Which service helps with this?
items.explanation: AWS Audit Manager continuously collects evidence and can generate reports that map it to controls for audits and compliance reviews.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A company stores sensitive customer data on an encrypted EBS volume. Which label best describes protecting the data while it is in this state?
items.explanation: Data is at rest when it is stored, and services such as EBS, S3, and RDS offer encryption keys for that stored data.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A web application uses TLS so data exchanged between the browser and the server cannot be read while it travels over the network. Which encryption state is this?
items.explanation: Data being moved across networks is in transit, and TLS encrypts that traffic to prevent interception and tampering in flight.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A compliance team must evaluate resources against internal rules and retain a full history of configuration changes. Which AWS service records and evaluates resource configuration?
items.explanation: AWS Config continuously records configuration changes, compares resources against rules, and reports compliance over time.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: An information security officer needs one dashboard that aggregates security findings and compliance status from multiple services and accounts. Which service provides this?
items.explanation: AWS Security Hub collects and prioritizes security findings across supported services and accounts, giving a consolidated view of posture.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A cloud administrator wants automated checks with recommendations for issues such as overly open security groups, alongside fault tolerance and cost checks. Which tool provides these checks?
items.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor inspects the account and delivers recommendations across cost, performance, security, fault tolerance, and service limits.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Security and Compliance

items.stem: A team needs resizable virtual servers over which it controls the guest operating system and installed software. Which AWS compute service is the best fit?
items.explanation: Amazon EC2 provides resizable virtual machines where the customer manages the guest OS, software, and supporting configuration layers.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A developer wants to run code in response to events without provisioning or managing servers, paying only for requests and execution time. Which service should be used?
items.explanation: AWS Lambda runs code in a serverless model, scaling automatically and billing only for the requests and compute time consumed.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A platform team must run containerized applications on a managed cluster using the EC2 launch type. Which AWS service provides this orchestration?
items.explanation: Amazon ECS is a managed container orchestration service that runs Docker containers as tasks using EC2 or Fargate launch types.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: An organization must run Kubernetes workloads but does not want to operate the Kubernetes control plane itself. Which AWS service is appropriate?
items.explanation: Amazon EKS is the managed Kubernetes service on AWS, handling the control plane while customers run worker nodes across their chosen infrastructure.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A data-heavy workload has strict latency and data residency requirements, and an architect must choose where the resources will be hosted. Which element of AWS global infrastructure is selected for this decision?
items.explanation: A Region is a separate geographic area of compute and storage, and choosing one governs latency proximity and where data physically resides for compliance.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: Which AWS global infrastructure element provides multiple, isolated locations within a Region so a workload can survive the loss of an entire facility?
items.explanation: Each Region has multiple Availability Zones, which are isolated data centers with independent power, cooling, and networking.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A global mobile app wants cached content served from locations physically close to its users to minimize latency. Which element of AWS global infrastructure is designed for this task?
items.explanation: Edge locations sit closer to end users and support CloudFront caching, reducing latency for content delivery without hosting general workloads.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: Which AWS service provides highly durable object storage with near-unlimited capacity, accessed over the internet, and suited to static assets and backups?
items.explanation: Amazon S3 is object storage that scales to any data volume, is reached through a web API, and is a common home for static assets and backups.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: An architect wants S3 to move objects automatically between storage classes as they age so hot data stays fast and cold data costs less. Which S3 feature performs this movement?
items.explanation: S3 lifecycle policies automate transitions between storage classes, such as moving old objects to Glacier for lower storage cost.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A database requires low-latency, durable block storage that attaches to one EC2 instance inside the same Availability Zone. Which AWS storage service is this?
items.explanation: Amazon EBS delivers block-level storage volumes attached to a single EC2 instance in the same AZ, offering consistent low-latency performance.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: Multiple EC2 instances spread across several Availability Zones must share a POSIX-compliant file system that grows automatically. Which AWS service supports this?
items.explanation: Amazon EFS is a managed network file system that multiple EC2 instances can mount at once and that scales capacity automatically.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A team wants a managed relational database supporting MySQL and PostgreSQL with automated backups and patching, without managing the database server. Which service should be used?
items.explanation: Amazon RDS manages relational database engines such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and MariaDB, handling backups, patching, and scaling.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: Which cloud-native relational database engine is compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL and is part of the RDS family?
items.explanation: Amazon Aurora is a MySQL- and PostgreSQL-compatible engine built for the cloud, with high availability and performance, managed under RDS.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A gaming company needs a NoSQL database serving requests in single-digit milliseconds at any scale, with serverless automatic scaling. Which service is designed for this?
items.explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed key-value NoSQL database with single-digit millisecond latency and automatic, serverless scaling.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A data team must run analytical queries across petabytes of structured data in a columnar data warehouse. Which AWS service fits this requirement?
items.explanation: Amazon Redshift is the petabyte-scale columnar data warehouse service optimized for analytic queries over structured data.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: An administrator needs a logically isolated section of AWS in which subnets, route tables, and gateways are defined for launching resources. Which service provides this virtual network?
items.explanation: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud gives a logically isolated private network with full control over subnets, routing, and gateway configuration.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: Which AWS service provides domain name resolution and supports routing policies such as latency-based and weighted routing, plus health checks?
items.explanation: Amazon Route 53 is a DNS service that resolves domain names and offers routing policies and health checks to direct traffic.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A company must deliver static content globally with low latency by serving it from a worldwide network of edge locations with caching. Which service is this?
items.explanation: Amazon CloudFront is the content delivery network that caches content at edge locations and serves viewers from the nearest node.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A fleet of EC2 instances must have incoming traffic spread automatically across healthy targets. Which AWS service performs this distribution?
items.explanation: Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming application traffic across targets such as EC2 instances and performs health checks.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: An operations team must collect metrics such as EC2 CPU utilization and trigger alarms when thresholds are breached. Which AWS service should be used?
items.explanation: Amazon CloudWatch collects metrics and logs from resources and applications, creates dashboards, and fires alarms on set thresholds.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A security team must review an audit log of API activity in an account, including who performed management actions and when. Which AWS service records this history?
items.explanation: AWS CloudTrail records API calls made in an account, capturing who, what, when, and from where they were made for auditing.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: An auditor needs continuous recording and evaluation of changes to resource configuration across the account. Which AWS service should be used?
items.explanation: AWS Config records configuration changes, evaluates resources against rules, and produces an audit trail of how each resource changed over time.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Cloud Technology and Services

items.stem: A startup accepts a pay-as-you-go model in which it is billed only for the compute it consumes and can scale down when demand drops, with no long-term commitment. Which pricing model is this?
items.explanation: On-Demand pricing charges per unit of usage with no upfront commitment, giving flexibility for unpredictable workloads.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Billing, Pricing, and Support

items.stem: A company has steady, predictable workloads and wants a large discount by committing to a consistent amount of usage over a one- or three-year term. Which option fits this need?
items.explanation: Savings Plans and Reserved Instances trade a commitment for discounted pricing on steady-state compute usage over one to three years.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Billing, Pricing, and Support

items.stem: A batch analytics job is interruptible and can tolerate being stopped, but the team wants the lowest possible compute price. Which EC2 purchasing option is designed for this case?
items.explanation: Spot Instances offer spare capacity at significant discounts and can be reclaimed by AWS, suiting flexible, fault-tolerant workloads.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Billing, Pricing, and Support

items.stem: A finance analyst wants to visualize and analyze historical AWS cost and usage data, such as spend by service over the past six months. Which AWS tool provides this view?
items.explanation: AWS Cost Explorer gives charts and queries over historical cost and usage data so teams can spot trends and optimize spend.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Billing, Pricing, and Support

items.stem: A team must be notified by email before the month's spend exceeds its target so corrective action can be taken early. Which AWS service should be configured?
items.explanation: AWS Budgets lets users set cost and usage thresholds and receive alerts when actual or forecast spend approaches or exceeds them.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Billing, Pricing, and Support

items.stem: A parent account wants a single bill for all linked member accounts so it can share volume discounts and credits across the companies it manages. Which facility provides this?
items.explanation: Consolidated billing in AWS Organizations combines member account usage into one bill and pools usage to share volume discounts and credits.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Billing, Pricing, and Support

items.stem: A large enterprise needs proactive architectural guidance, fast response times for production incidents, and a designated technical account manager. Which AWS Support plan provides the highest level of these benefits?
items.explanation: Enterprise Support is the highest tier, adding a technical account manager, proactive guidance, and the fastest response times.
items.reference: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam Guide - Billing, Pricing, and Support
